input: Assemble the flat-pack bookshelf in the hallway

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: Knowing whether assembly includes wall-mounting or anchoring changes the tools, steps, and safety considerations involved.
Some flat-pack furniture requires two people to hold panels; knowing if help is available affects how steps are sequenced.
The hallway may have limited floor space to lay out parts, which affects how the work area is set up before starting.
A hard deadline (e.g. guests arriving, delivery expected) determines urgency and whether the task needs to be split into sessions.
Knowing whether the right tools (screwdriver, mallet, allen key) are already on hand prevents mid-task blockers.
The user may want to follow the manufacturer instructions strictly, use online video guides, or rely on experience — this shapes the plan's format.
Done well could mean simply standing upright, or it could include being level, secured to the wall, and styled with items — this defines the finish line.

gold.taskTitle: Assemble flat-pack bookshelf in the hallway
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to build and install a flat-pack bookshelf in their hallway.

questions.title: Does the bookshelf need to be wall-mounted or anchored?
questions.description: Determines whether the assembly task ends at a freestanding unit or includes drilling into the wall for securing.

questions.title: Will you be assembling this alone or with help?
questions.description: Identifies whether a second person is available to hold panels, which affects how steps are ordered and described.

questions.title: How much floor space is available in the hallway to lay out parts?
questions.description: Narrow hallways may require parts to be staged in an adjacent room first, changing the setup steps.

questions.title: Do you have a specific deadline for finishing the assembly?
questions.description: A time constraint determines whether this is a single focused session or can be split across multiple sittings.

questions.title: Which tools do you currently have available at home?
questions.description: Confirms whether essentials like a mallet, screwdriver, or allen key are on hand, or if anything needs to be sourced first.

questions.title: Do you prefer to follow the manual or a video walkthrough?
questions.description: Shapes how the step-by-step plan is presented — text-based instructions referencing the manual vs. directing to visual resources.

questions.title: What does a fully completed job look like to you?
questions.description: Clarifies the finish line — whether it is just structurally built, or also level, stable, and ready to be loaded with books.
